title: Wire up formula button to open FormulaComposer modal
body: The math formula button (labeled 'f') currently toggles isFormulaOpen state but the actual FormulaComposer popup is not rendered. The _handleFormulaInsert callback is ready to use once the FormulaComposer is integrated into the expanded panel.
rationale: The issue requires math support in the input panel, but the actual formula editor popup wasn't implemented due to complexity.
